verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server docs explicitly support creating and managing tasks and projects through natural language, with example queries such as "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week" and report generation. Interactive tools with confirmation UIs work in Claude and ChatGPT, and an official Asana app runs inside Claude conversations. In-product AI Teammates and Asana Dash add AI agent surfaces inside Asana itself. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and detailed documentation of a native in-app natural-language command interface (Dash and AI Studio appear only as marketing taglines).
